Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character

Class Character

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character
All Implemented Interfaces:
Damageable, Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Enemy, Player
public abstract class Character extends Entity implements Damageable
Base class for player and enemy entities, with shared health and damage handling. The final onUpdate(long) method performs common per-tick bookkeeping before delegating character-specific behavior to think(long).

  • Constructor Details

    • Character

      protected Character(Aabb bodyBox, StatSource stats, Attack baseAttack, Aabb hurtbox, int invincibilityTicksAfterHit, World world)
      Creates a character with the specified body box, stats, base attack, hurtbox, and post-hit invincibility duration. Its build starts as its stats and base attack (GDD 1.3.1). It starts with full HP.
      Parameters:
      bodyBox - the box the character occupies in the world; must not be null
      stats - where its stats come from (GDD 1.6), usually BaseStats, which checks the values; must not be null
      baseAttack - its attack before any item: the starting weapon of a player, the natural attack of an enemy; must not be null
      hurtbox - the character's hurtbox; must not be null
      invincibilityTicksAfterHit - the number of invincibility ticks granted after taking damage; must not be negative
      world - the world it lives in; its event bus gets the damage and death of status effects
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if invincibilityTicksAfterHit is negative
      NullPointerException - if bodyBox, stats, baseAttack, hurtbox or world is null

    • Character

      protected Character(Aabb bodyBox, StatSource stats, Attack baseAttack, Aabb hurtbox, int invincibilityTicksAfterHit, World world, List<BuildModifier> startingModifiers)
      Creates a character that starts with items already applied to its build, such as a player's starting weapon and armor. It starts with full HP, cut down to the max HP of that build.
      Parameters:
      bodyBox - the box the character occupies in the world; must not be null
      stats - where its stats come from (GDD 1.6); must not be null
      baseAttack - its attack before any item; must not be null
      hurtbox - the character's hurtbox; must not be null
      invincibilityTicksAfterHit - the number of invincibility ticks granted after taking damage; must not be negative
      world - the world it lives in
      startingModifiers - the modifiers applied to its build from the start, in order, as in rebuild(java.util.List<com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.stats.BuildModifier>); must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if invincibilityTicksAfterHit is negative
      NullPointerException - if an argument or one of the modifiers is null

    • startAttackCooldown

      public void startAttackCooldown(int swingTicks)
      Starts an attack: the swing runs first, then the character waits 60 / ATTACK_SPEED ticks, rounded and at least 1, before the next one. ATTACK_SPEED comes from the build, so the weapon's speed already counts in it (GDD 1.3.1). The cooldown only counts down once the swing is over, so two swings never overlap (DECISIONS §5).
      Parameters:
      swingTicks - how many ticks the swing of the weapon lasts; 0 for an attack with no swing
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if swingTicks is negative
      IllegalStateException - if the character cannot attack now (see canAttack())

    • startAttack

      protected final void startAttack(Attack weapon, float aimDegrees, World world)
      Attacks towards the aim with a weapon, whatever its kind: a sword starts a swing, a bow will shoot an arrow. A player or an enemy calls it from think(long), once canAttack() is true. Publishes AttackStarted once the attack has started, so a failed attack makes no sound.
      Parameters:
      weapon - the attack to start, usually the equipped weapon
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      world - the world the attack happens in
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim is not a finite number
      IllegalStateException - if this character cannot attack now (see canAttack())

    • takeStatusDamage

      public void takeStatusDamage(int amount, Character source)
      Takes damage from a status effect, such as a burn tick (GDD 1.3.1). Unlike takeDamage(int), it ignores invincibility and grants none: a burn keeps ticking during the frames after a hit, and never blocks the next hit. The amount is applied as is, without the damage formula. It publishes a DamageDealt, then an EntityDied if it kills, both credited to the source. Does nothing once the character is dead.
      Parameters:
      amount - the HP to lose; must be at least 1
      source - the character who applied the effect
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if amount is less than 1
      NullPointerException - if source is null

    • rebuild

      public final void rebuild(List<BuildModifier> modifiers)
      Rebuilds what this character fights with (GDD 1.3.1): starts again from its base build and applies each modifier in order (weapon, then armor, then passive items in pickup order). If the new max HP is below the current HP, the HP is cut down to it.
      Parameters:
      modifiers - the modifiers in the order to apply them; an empty list gives the base build
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if modifiers or one of them is null

    • readState

      public void readState(StateBuffer in)
      Puts back what writeState(com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.StateBuffer) wrote, in the same order: a swing started after the photo is gone, one already running goes on. The status effects are not in the photo: they are dropped, a choice made to keep the rewind simple (a burn stops when R is used).

      Overrides:
